# stb_image

This directory contains `stb_image.h` from the official `nothings/stb`
repository at commit `28d546d5eb77d4585506a20480f4de2e706dff4c`.

- Source: `https://github.com/nothings/stb`
- File SHA-256:
  `594C2FE35D49488B4382DBFAEC8F98366DEFCA819D916AC95BECF3E75F4200B3`
